rationale_md: Germany enters this Group E opener as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 260-point Elo rating advantage that reflects the gulf in class between a perennial World Cup contender and an African side still building consistency at the highest level. The Germans' 72% win probability in our model underscores their technical superiority and tournament pedigree, though Ivory Coast has shown flashes of talent with their athletic, counter-attacking style. Germany should control possession and create numerous chances, making anything but a comfortable victory a genuine surprise.
